claims.value: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 is a large language model trained from scratch by NVIDIA, designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks using a hybrid Mamba-2 and MLP architecture.
claims.evidence: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 is a large language model (LLM) trained from scratch by NVIDIA, and designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks.

claims.value: The model supports English and coding languages primarily, with German, French, Italian, Spanish, and Japanese also supported.
claims.evidence: Other non-English languages (German, French, Italian, Spanish and Japanese) are also supported.
This model supports runtime “thinking” budget control. During inference, the user can specify how many tokens the model is allowed to "think".

claims.value: In reasoning-on mode, AIME25=72.1%, MATH500=97.8%, GPQA=64.0%, LCB=71.1%
BFCL v3 score is 66.9% in reasoning-on mode
